title: dryopteris macrophylla
intro: Dryopteris macrophylla, commonly known as the Osmundopteris or the broad buckler fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris macrophylla include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant contribute to its therapeutic properties, making it a subject of interest for further research in the field of traditional medicine and pharmacology.
